# Fermat varieties X^n_m: Hodge classes vs. the inductive structure

Columns: `b_prim` = primitive middle Betti number; `dim Hdg` = dim_Q of rational Hodge classes in H^n (= |B^n_m| + 1); `decomposable` = dimension of the span of Hodge characters reachable from points and surfaces by the Shioda-Katsura operations (N)/(Z) (see docs/04-fermat-computations.md); `indecomposable` = the rest; `orbits` = number of Galois-and-permutation orbits of indecomposable characters; `verified` = HC for X^n_m follows from the inductive structure + Lefschetz (1,1) alone.

## Open degrees 44, 51, 52 (2026-11)

* `exceptional_lengths.md` — Theorem D of `docs/fermat/02-exceptional-lengths.md`, checked for every family degree
  q ≤ 420 (`python3 scripts/exceptional_lengths.py 420`).
* `galois_obstruction.md` — the Galois field-of-definition test of `docs/fermat/03-galois-obstruction.md` for the
  exceptional tuples ξ_q, q < 70, in their own degree and multiples up to 572 (`python3 scripts/galois_obstruction.py`).
* `weil_route.md` — the reach of Markman's theorems on the open classes (`docs/fermat/04-weil-route.md`): simple CM
  factors of J(C_q), Theorems W1–W3, all exceptional classes with q < 70, realizations, and the Galois test for lifts
  (`python3 scripts/weil_route.py 572 --search`).
* `gamma_periods.txt` — the squares θ_q of Deligne's Γ-monomials of ξ_44, ξ_51, ξ_52 as explicit products of sines and
  radicals, checked to 60 digits (`python3 scripts/gamma_periods.py`).
* `fermat_formal_module.txt`, `fermat_span/` — Attack 17 and the span test (python-flint, PARI).
